description: Vendor text using lookalike Unicode characters (homoglyphs) that visually appear identical to ASCII letters but are different Unicode points (e.g., Cyrillic 'А' U+0410 vs. Latin 'A' U+0041). These do not match the ban-pattern scan's ASCII-based patterns, but stripping controls is still required. The run behavior is invariant with benign text.
